title: Colimits of pointwise pushout squares
statement: Let $J$ be a small ordinary category and let $\mathcal A$ be an ordinary category with small Hom sets and all small colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $F_0,F_1,F_2,F_3:J\to\mathcal A$ be functors and let $a:F_0\to F_1$, $b:F_0\to F_2$, $c:F_1\to F_3$, $d:F_2\to F_3$ be natural transformations. Suppose that for every $j\in J$ the square with edges $a_j,b_j,c_j,d_j$ commutes and is a pushout, meaning that $F_3(j)$ with its displayed legs is a colimit of the span $F_1(j)\leftarrow F_0(j)\to F_2(j)$. Then the square with vertices $\operatorname{colim}_J F_0$, $\operatorname{colim}_J F_1$, $\operatorname{colim}_J F_2$, $\operatorname{colim}_J F_3$ and respective edges $\operatorname{colim}_J a$, $\operatorname{colim}_J b$, $\operatorname{colim}_J c$, $\operatorname{colim}_J d$ is a pushout with precisely these induced legs. No filteredness or connectedness of $J$ is required.
